titulo_es: Source and affirmation · He said that

texto: In the indirect style, «at» introduces an affirmation and «om» can enter a yes / no question. Times do not change in a mechanical way: it retains the meaning and time reference of the text.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
